question: Which of the following is a string instrument commonly featured in the folk music of Gujarat?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jantar**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jantar** is a string instrument commonly featured in the folk music of Gujarat.
 
• It is **often used in traditional performances and folk songs.**
 
• It is** made from bamboo and has a simple design with strings** stretched across a resonating box, which produces sound when the strings are plucked.
 
• The Jantar is often played by folk musicians, especially in rural areas, and is typically used to accompany singing or storytelling.
 
• It has a **deep, resonant sound **and is closely associated with tribal and nomadic communities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bungal**, **Pava**, and **Turi** are wind instruments

 
 
• **Bungal**

 
 
• **It** is a traditional wind instrument, often associated with nomadic and pastoral communities of Gujarat.
 
• It is a long, curved trumpet made from copper or brass and produces a loud, piercing sound.
 
• Bungal is typically used in ceremonial music or during martial events.
 
 
 
• **Pava**
 
 
• **It** is a folk wind instrument similar to a flute.
 
• It is made from bamboo and is played by blowing air across one end while covering the finger holes to produce different notes.
 
• It is used in various folk performances and devotional music in Gujarat.
 
 
 
• **Turi**
 
 
• **​It** is another wind instrument, commonly used in Gujarat’s folk traditions.
 
• It is a horn-like instrument that produces a loud sound and is often played during festive or ceremonial occasions.
